node.statement: There are universal C_proj<infinity and e_proj>0 such that every finite-dimensional extended epsilon_X-C*-algebra (calX,I_X,.,dagger) with 0<=epsilon_X<=e_proj and 1<dim_C calX<infinity contains a nontrivial C_proj*epsilon_X-projection P_0 for the original product and original unit I_X.
